author: beamact5 worker (DSH)

approval.basis: 사용자 규칙상 코호트/실행조건 deviation은 조정자 승인+사전등록+기록으로 허용. world15 제외는 성공률을 낮추는 방향(15=FAIL 고정)이라 부풀리기가 아니다.

excluded_world.reason: world15 teacher logs explode: repeated 91-pose blocked_goal goal_set/search22 audits every 0.1 s grew the runner payload to diagnostic-snapshot.json 3,001,561,296 B and an interrupt-flushed result.json 3,199,783,993 B (other worlds ~5 MB), stalling the whole batch. r3 code path does not trip the 30 wall-s planning safety cap that ended r2 world15 at SIM 6.4. This is a logging/serialisation volume defect, not a physics/control result.
excluded_world.future_use: world15 is excluded from any future teacher recording/dataset build and must not be used until the log-volume defect is fixed

criterion.nominal_rule: nominal 38/40 (world15 counted as FAIL in the denominator)
criterion.execute_rule: among the 39 executed worlds at least 38 must succeed (at most one non-15 failure)
criterion.known_structural: world37 is the pre-registered structural expected fail (4.87 mm < runtime floor 11.07 mm); if 37 also fails, success = 38/40 = exactly the minimum

stack_deviations.direction: lowers success rate, 15 fixed as FAIL
stack_deviations.reversible: logging fix 후 별도 재실행으로만 검증

not_claimed: teacher success is not student success
